prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a sedan and an SUV. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling straight through the intersection when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 turned left across their path, resulting in a broadside impact to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they were turning left on a green arrow and did not see Driver 1 approaching until the moment of impact. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was present and was not injured. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and requested medical evaluation; EMS was contacted and evaluated Driver 1 at the scene. Both vehicles sustained front-end and side damage and were not drivable without towing. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Witness statements and photographs were collected and are attached to this report.
